answer_1.quote: We apply the framework to two tasks: news summarization using CNN/DM and medical suggestion generation using the Taiwan e-Hospital Dataset.
answer_1.outputs: Explanations, generated summaries, medical suggestions, counterfactual texts, atomic‑unit annotations

answer_2.quote: Finally, generality and precision scores are calculated following §4.4.

answer_3.quote: We assess the feasibility of using an LLM to automate human annotation in our evaluation pipeline and find that doing so achieves agreement with humans comparable to agreement among human annotators.
methods: automated annotation via prompting (explanation decomposition, counterfactual generation, simulatability/precision labeling)

answer_4.quote: We assigned 3 student annotators per task to evaluate 15 explanations along with 3 generated counterfactuals each ... Annotators examine the counterfactual and counterfactual output to annotate simulatability and precision for each atomic unit of the explanation.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators evaluate each atomic unit of the explanation for simulatability (presence in counterfactual) and precision (presence in counterfactual output), and also check correctness of explanation parsing.
